major_events: Fang Yuan self-detonates using the Spring Autumn Cicada (春秋蝉) in '第一节：纵身亡魔心仍不悔' when cornered by righteous forces, sending his consciousness 500 years back into his youth.
Fang Yuan's twin brother Fang Zheng is revealed to have A-grade aptitude during the Awakening Ceremony in '第五节：人祖三蛊，希望开窍', while Fang Yuan only achieves C-grade aptitude.
Fang Yuan recalls historical rumors of the Flower Wine Monk's (花酒行者) death near the village in '第七节：蛊师有九转，花酒留遗藏', planning to locate his secret inheritance.
Fang Yuan discovers the hidden fissure entrance to the Flower Wine Monk's inheritance under a cracked red clay rock in the bamboo forest in '第十三节：月下竹林，一点珠雪'.
Fang Yuan refines a wild Liquor Worm (酒虫) obtained from the inheritance through a grueling battle of willpower in '第十七节：初炼酒虫'.
Fang Yuan utilizes the high-rank aura pressure of the Spring Autumn Cicada to quickly refine it as his vital Gu in '第十九节：六转本命春秋蝉！'.
Fang Yuan defeats and extorts his classmates for primeval stones in '第二十七节：公然勒索', starting a daily extortion racket in the academy.
Fang Yuan purchases purple gold stones from the Jia caravan and successfully gambles out a Mudskin Toad Gu in '第四十节：紫金石中蟾蛊眠'.
Fang Yuan murders the merchant caravan heir Jia Jin Sheng in '第四停七节：贾金生，其实我不想杀你的' (referring to '第四十七节：贾金生，其实我不想杀你的') to keep his secrets safe and hide the body in the swamp.
Fang Yuan is nominated as class monitor due to his combat record and uses a calculated explanation to clear himself of suspicion in '第五十三节：方源就任命你为班头'.
Fang Yuan breaks the shadow wall in the secret cave in '第六十节：影灭壁破现甬道，魔道传承岂易', uncovering the next stage of the Flower Wine Monk's inheritance.
Fang Yuan refines the White Boar Gu (白豕蛊) in '第七十节：使用白豕蛊' to permanently increase his physical strength to the limit of a boar's power.
Fang Yuan overcomes the trial in the secret cave to obtain the Earth Hearing Meat Ear Grass (地听肉耳草) in '第七十九节：突破遗藏第六蛊'.
Fang Yuan breaks through the bottleneck of Rank 1 peak stage to reach Rank 2 initial stage in '第八十一节：二转初阶！'.
Fang Yuan ruthlessly defeats his brother Fang Zheng during the academy year-end combat test in '第八十四节：狠狠地踩踏！'.
Fang Yuan slays the monkey king in the Flower Wine inheritance cave to obtain the Plunder Gu (强取蛊) in '第一百一十六节：斩杀猴王得新蛊'.
Fang Yuan refines the Four-Flavor Liquor Worm (四味酒虫) in '第一百二十一节：四味酒虫' using Sweet, Sour, Bitter, and Spicy wines.
Gu Yue Qing Shu sacrifices his life using the Wood Charm Gu to counter Bai Ning Bing's extreme ice capabilities, dying as a tree in '第一百四十二节：古月青书VS白凝冰（下）'.
Fang Yuan knocks out Gu Yue Yao Le and sacrifices her to refine the Man-Beast Life Burial Gu (人兽葬生蛊) in '第一百五十一节：魔性（第一更）'.
Fang Yuan uses the Man-Beast Life Burial Gu to forcefully break through to Rank 3 initial stage in '第一百五十二节：晋升三转（第二更）'.
Fang Yuan blackmails the Chi faction leader Gu Yue Chi Lian using Chi Cheng's false aptitude secret, securing 3000 primeval stones in '第一百五十五节：借'.
character_state_transitions: Fang Yuan transitions from a dying Rank 6 peak demon emperor in '第一节：纵身亡魔心仍不悔' to a 15-year-old mortal youth with C-grade aptitude in '第二节：逆光阴五百年觉悟'.
Fang Zheng transitions from an insecure, overlooked orphan sibling to the premier A-grade genius of the Gu Yue clan in '第五节：人祖三蛊，希望开窍'.
Fang Yuan transitions from a mortal without cultivation to a Rank 1 initial stage Gu master in '第五节：人祖三蛊，希望开窍'.
Fang Yuan transitions from Rank 1 initial stage to Rank 1 middle stage after refining the Liquor Worm in '第十七节：初炼酒虫'.
Fang Yuan transitions from Rank 1 middle stage to Rank 1 peak stage through persistent training using raw primeval stones.
Fang Yuan transitions from Rank 1 peak stage to Rank 2 initial stage in '第八十一节：二转初阶！'.
Fang Yuan transitions from Rank 2 initial stage to Rank 2 middle stage in '第一百一十五节：晋升中阶'.
Fang Yuan transitions from Rank 2 middle stage to Rank 3 initial stage in '第一百五十二节：晋升三转（第二更）', obtaining elder status.
Gu Yue Chi Cheng transitions from a protected B-grade prodigy to a blackmailed fraud whose C-grade aptitude is held hostage by Fang Yuan.
Bai Ning Bing transitions from a detached solitary genius to a desperate fighter facing the fatal overload of the Northern Dark Ice Soul physique in '第一百三十五节：北冥冰魄，十绝天资'.
Gu Yue Qing Shu transitions from a respected faction successor to a dead martyr whose life was consumed by the Wood Charm Gu in '第一百四十四节：牺牲常在，而信念不死'.
long_form_mechanisms: Aperture Aptitude and true essence limits: Aptitude grades (A/B/C/D) determine the maximum primeval essence storage (A-grade allows 90%, C-grade caps at 44-59%) and speed of cultivation.

Spring Autumn Cicada Time-Reversal: A Rank 6 Gu that allows the user's consciousness to travel back in time by self-detonating their physical body and aperture, placing extreme physical pressure on a low-level aperture.
Gu Refinement via Willpower Subjugation: The process of using one's own primeval essence to wear down and overwrite the wild will of a Gu worm, as shown in '第十七节：初炼酒虫'.

Liquor Worm Essence Refining: The mechanism where the Liquor Worm consumes Rank 1 initial stage green copper essence and refines it into Rank 1 middle stage essence, bypassing the natural aptitude quality constraints of the Gu master.

Boar Gu Strength Transference: The process where a Gu (like the White Boar Gu in '第七十节：使用白豕蛊') consumes primeval essence to permanently modify the user's muscles and bones, transferring the strength of a beast to a human body.

Four-Flavor Liquor Worm Synthesis: A recipe that fuses two Liquor Worms along with Sweet, Sour, Bitter, and Spicy wines under specific conditions, allowing Rank 2 primeval essence refinement in '第一百二十一节：四味酒虫'.

Ten Extreme Physiques Overload: Physiques like the Northern Dark Ice Soul (北冥冰魄体) that possess 100% aperture purity. While they grant unparalleled cultivation speed and power, they eventually cause the aperture to overload and self-detonate.
Earth Hearing Meat Ear Grass Scouting limits: A scouting Gu that functions by planting its roots into the earth to capture sound waves. Its range is halved when it is not rooted.

Man-Beast Life Burial Gu Refinement: A forbidden demonic refinement method requiring the sacrifice of a pure human girl and a beast inside a soil pit to produce a Gu that can forcefully break through the Rank 2 to Rank 3 cultivation bottleneck.
continuity_observations: Flower Wine Monk Legacy Consistency: Fang Yuan's memory of the Flower Wine Monk's death site from his past life matches the physical topography of the cave system and bamboo forest.

Gu Yue Chi Cheng's Slow Progress: Chi Cheng's slow cultivation speed despite his purported B-grade aptitude is what initially tips Fang Yuan off about his cheating, showing a consistent link between aptitude, resources, and progress.

Jia Jin Sheng's Caravan Standing: Jia Jin Sheng is established as a spoiled and incompetent younger brother of the merchant family. His death triggers an investigation by Jia Fu, which remains a primary driving subplot.
Wolf Tide foreshadowing: The small wolf pack attacks in early chapters serve as natural foreshadowing for the massive Wolf Tide that forces the three rival clans on Qingmao Mountain to ally.

Bai Ning Bing's Early Reputation: Long before he appears in person, Bai Ning Bing is discussed by elders as a terrifying genius of the Bai clan, creating consistent build-up to his character's entrance.

Uncle and Aunt's Inheritance Plot: The uncle and aunt's conspiracy to keep the inheritance relies on a clan law that orphans cannot claim family property unless they reach Rank 2 by age 16. Fang Yuan's breakthrough in '第八十一节：二转初阶！' resolves this plotline.

Divine Investigator's Limits: Jia Fu brings an investigator to trace Jia Jin Sheng's killer, but because Fang Yuan dissolved the body in a swamp and used Mudskin Toad, the investigation stalls realistically.

Earth Hearing Meat Ear Grass Mobility Constraint: When running, Fang Yuan observes that the scouting range of the Earth Hearing Meat Ear Grass is reduced to less than half because its roots cannot anchor in the soil, maintaining mechanical consistency.

Gu Yue Qing Shu's Faction Goal: Qing Shu's consistent devotion to protecting the clan and securing Fang Zheng's growth culminates in his decision to sacrifice himself against Bai Ning Bing, aligning with his established character motives.
style_observations: Philosophical and Cynical Prose: The narrative frequently inserts philosophical musings on the nature of morality, organization, and power, contrasting societal rules with raw natural selection (e.g. '第二十六节：一切组织的本质').
Nature as a Cold Mirror: The harsh winters, snowstorms, and wild beasts of Qingmao Mountain are used to mirror the cold, calculating mindset of the protagonist.

Contrast between Demonic Pragmatism and Righteous Hypocrisy: The author constantly juxtaposes Fang Yuan's honest demonic ruthlessness against the righteous faction's face-saving tactics and institutional hypocrisy.
Use of Fables and Legends: The story regularly references 'The Legends of Ren Zu' (人祖传) to explain biological or mechanical aspects of the Gu world, functioning as in-universe parables.
Slow-paced, Resource-centric Progression: Cultivation is depicted not just as sudden epiphanies, but as a grinding economy of primeval stones, food, and Gu maintenance.
Detailed Tactical Combat Choreography: Fights are described in terms of specific Gu functions, cooldowns, true essence percentages, and terrain layout rather than abstract energy blasts.

Direct Author Intrusion (PS/Remarks): The author frequently uses postscript remarks in brackets (e.g., in chapters 144, 150, 151) to discuss real-life writing conditions, plan alterations, and respond to reader comments.

creation_family_evidence.web_scraper_markers: The text contains scraping artifacts from '138看书网' (www.13800100.com), such as injected lines in Chapter 132: '第一百三十二节：三步芳草来自138看书网' and '第一百三十二节：三步芳草更新完毕！'.
creation_family_evidence.author_postscripts: The text contains raw author notes in parentheses (e.g. at the end of Chapter 150), where the author talks about being tired but writing with excitement and asking readers for votes.
creation_family_evidence.outline_updates: In Chapter 123's preamble, the author writes a detailed note explaining that they spent a lot of time rewriting the outline over the Chinese New Year to make the story tighter, and explains that the deleted chapter 121 draft titled 'Earth Hearing Meat Ear Grass' was accidentally seen by some readers.
creation_family_evidence.censorship_adjustments: In the postscript of Chapter 151, the author explains that they initially wanted to write a more gruesome refinement method named 'Man-Beast Mutual Burial Gu' (人兽葬生蛊) but censored/shortened it to 'Burial Gu' (葬生) due to online censorship considerations.
creation_family_evidence.vip_group_promos: The author includes notes promoting their QQ VIP reader group (group ID: 250906315) and QQ official group (group ID: 130985234) for storyline discussion, requiring verification of full subscription.
creation_family_evidence.publishing_frequency_remarks: In the postscript of Chapter 146, the author apologizes for unstable update schedules, explaining that they are not a full-time writer and have real-life responsibilities.

originality_risks: Reincarnation/Rebirth Trope (重生/穿越): The core premise of a modern person reincarnating into a fantasy world, only to self-detonate and go back in time, is a highly common trope in Chinese web novels.
Ruthless/Anti-Hero Protagonist: The cold-blooded, emotionless main character who extorts classmates and commits murder for pragmatism aligns closely with dark-fantasy tropes, which can risk edginess.
Talent/Aptitude Testing System: The school-based aptitude awakening ceremony with color-coded grades (A/B/C/D) and direct social hierarchy changes is a standard setup in many cultivation novels.
Twin Sibling Rivalry: The dynamic of twin brothers where one is a rejected underachiever and the other is a feted genius is a classic narrative formula for generating conflict.

Forbidden Demonic Sacrificing Methods: The concept of sacrificing an innocent girl (Yao Le) and a beast to refine a breakthrough Gu is a common motif in dark cultivation novels, risking formulaic horror tropes.
